questions.question: Which group formed the First Estate in pre-revolutionary France?
choices: Nobility
Clergy
Peasants
Urban artisans

questions.question: Which estate included most of France's population?
choices: First Estate
Second Estate
Royal household
Third Estate

questions.question: Who was king of France when the Revolution began in 1789?
choices: Louis XVI
Louis XIV
Charles X
Louis XVIII

questions.question: What representative body did Louis XVI summon in 1789?
choices: Directory
Committee of Public Safety
Estates-General
Council of Five Hundred

questions.question: What did the Tennis Court Oath promise?
choices: To restore all feudal dues
To remain assembled until a constitution was established
To crown Napoleon emperor
To dissolve the National Assembly immediately

questions.question: Which event occurred in Paris on July 14, 1789?
choices: Storming of the Bastille
Execution of Louis XVI
Napoleon's coronation
Fall of Robespierre

questions.question: Which leader is closely associated with the Reign of Terror?
choices: Louis XVIII
Charles de Gaulle
Otto von Bismarck
Maximilien Robespierre

questions.question: How did poor harvests contribute to revolutionary unrest?
choices: They eliminated government debt
They made bread widely available at lower prices
Food shortages and higher bread prices increased hardship
They reduced demands for political reform

questions.question: Why did voting by estate disadvantage the Third Estate?
choices: The two privileged estates could combine to outvote it
Third Estate delegates had more votes than both other estates
The king was legally required to follow the Third Estate
Every French adult could vote directly in the assembly

questions.question: Which principle appeared in the Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen?
choices: Hereditary exemption from every tax
Equality before the law
Unlimited royal authority
Exclusive political rights for clergy

questions.question: What political system did the Constitution of 1791 establish?
choices: Absolute monarchy
Military dictatorship
Federal republic
Constitutional monarchy

questions.question: Why did the king's attempted flight in 1791 damage his position?
choices: It proved that he supported abolishing monarchy
It made foreign rulers recognize French independence
It increased doubts about his loyalty to the Revolution
It eliminated the National Assembly's authority

questions.question: Why did revolutionary leaders create the Committee of Public Safety?
choices: To defend the republic against internal and external threats
To negotiate Napoleon's exile
To restore the Estates-General's old voting system
To appoint Louis XVI as constitutional monarch

questions.question: What happened to the French monarchy in 1792?
choices: It became more absolute than before 1789
It was abolished and a republic was proclaimed
It was transferred to the British royal family
It was restored after Napoleon's defeat

questions.question: What was the Directory?
choices: The assembly that wrote the Tennis Court Oath
The hereditary council that advised Louis XIV
The army that invaded France in 1815
The government that ruled France before Napoleon's 1799 coup

questions.question: Which sequence places these French Revolution events in chronological order?
choices: Bastille stormed, monarchy abolished, Estates-General meets
Monarchy abolished, Estates-General meets, Bastille stormed
Estates-General meets, Bastille stormed, monarchy abolished
Estates-General meets, monarchy abolished, Bastille stormed

questions.question: Which example illustrates the abolition of feudal privilege?
choices: Ending special obligations peasants owed to nobles
Granting nobles exclusive access to public office
Allowing clergy alone to collect national taxes
Restoring voting by estate

questions.question: Which comparison describes a contradiction of the Terror?
choices: Leaders ended warfare while eliminating the military
Leaders defended monarchy while abolishing elections everywhere
Leaders restored feudal dues while banning taxes
Leaders defended liberty while using political repression

questions.question: Which evidence challenges the claim that revolutionary equality immediately included everyone?
choices: The Bastille was stormed in 1789
Women and enslaved people did not receive equal rights consistently
The Estates-General met at Versailles
The Directory had five executive directors

questions.question: Which conclusion about the Revolution's broader influence is defensible?
choices: It permanently ended all European monarchies
It prevented nationalist movements from developing
It spread ideas of rights and popular sovereignty beyond France
It created immediate political stability throughout Europe
